summary: Completed backend + frontend validation for Customer Order Overview and Invoice Overview regression. API contract, raw-data reconciliation, grouping/dedup, exports, sorting, filters, resizing persistence/reset, route load, and desktop/mobile overflow checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Maintainability risk: /app/backend/server.py is very large (>11k lines), well beyond the 700-line guideline. Split into focused modules to reduce regression risk and speed root-cause analysis.
Testability gap: Login email input and Sign In button still lack stable data-testid attributes, making UI automation more brittle than required standards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: COO desktop/mobile checks passed on public preview URL. localStorage key coo-col-widths-v1 is created by resize and removed by Reset column widths. Console showed only expected pre-login /api/auth/me 401 and non-blocking cdn-cgi/rum aborted requests.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found in tested scope. Earlier test collection failure was from quoted .env values in test harness and was corrected in the test file by stripping quotes when reading backend env vars.
